notes: Statistical evaluation is the primary oracle. Heuristic clones are never labelled trained.

steps.name: policy_manifest_present
cmd: import json; from pathlib import Path; m=json.load(open('godot_project/content/policies/manifest.json')); assert m['heuristic_fallback'].get('trained') is False; q=int(m.get('qualified_count') or 0); review=Path('Pack/DuelMasterBattle_Build_Pack/tracking/gates/G09/MORNING_REVIEW.md'); assert review.is_file(); print('MANIFEST_OK', m.get('status'), q); print('GATE_STATUS=' + ('AUTO_READY_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW' if q>=3 else ('PARTIAL_BLOCKED' if review.stat().st_size>0 else 'AUTO_FAILED')))
